system.description:
When a creature attempts to dash, disengage, grapple, disarm, shove or forcefully move you, while they are within your Executioners Instrument range, you can make one weapon attack against them.

Once per turn, when a creature within 30 feet of you attempts to attack an allied creature that is also, within 30 feet of you, you can spend your reaction to move up to your speed, ending it adjacent to your ally and attempting to parry the blow by rolling your [Weapon Damage] die and adding half the result to your allies AC. If the attacking creature misses, you deal your [Weapon Damage] to them.
